title: Act: Implement the report writer package
description: Create the report package with Report struct and Writer.Write that validates the id, then writes JSON atomically.

steps.action: Create package report with struct Report with json tags: ExecutionID execution_id string, RoundID round_id string, Status store.Status status, Attempts attempts int, Error error string, StartedAt started_at time.Time, FinishedAt finished_at time.Time, DurationMS duration_ms int64

Add Writer{dir string}, New(dir) *Writer, and Write(r Report) error: call store.ValidateID(r.ExecutionID) first and return its error; os.MkdirAll(dir,0o755); json.MarshalIndent; os.CreateTemp(dir, ".tmp-*"); write, close, os.Rename to filepath.Join(dir, id+".json"); remove temp on failure
steps.expected: Valid report yields <dir>/<id>.json; invalid id returns before touching disk
